If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in late horizon (day 25–30) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% in mid horizon (day 15–24) to compensate for bearish bias.  
If sentiment swings sharply from positive to negative within 5 days, shift forecast downward by 2–3% starting from day 10 onward.  
If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and price is trending upward, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast in early horizon (day 1–10) to capture momentum.  
If sentiment is neutral and price is trending downward, subtract 0.5–1.0% from forecast in early horizon (day 1–10) to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is positive but price is declining, reduce forecast by 1–2% in mid horizon (day 11–20) to align with sentiment divergence.
